title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured on 2026-08-24 against origin/main e31089c and independently reproduced on the committed tree b36bfe3 the same day. Reconciled on 2026-08-28 with QS-86 (deterministic static-analysis evidence), which landed on origin/main in the interim and shares one file (Program.cs) with this card; both feature sets coexist without conflict, and the full gate plus the 13-point tree-v2 contract harness reproduce clean.
